title: NHI component to the New Jersey drone flap

tellings.quote: I do think that there was a an NH NHI component to this combined

plain: The wave of mysterious drone sightings over New Jersey in 2024 had, mixed in with other things, an NHI component, meaning non-human intelligence. Jake Barber, who says he once carried a recovered UFO with his helicopter, gives this as his own view rather than something he saw. If true, some of what people saw over New Jersey would not have been made by people.
